suzeren_t: ≤-1364 (Erība-Adad I saltanatı 1390–1364; RIAo 'Mittani Client' dönemi 1364'te biter, Aššur-uballiṭ I ile 1363'te 'Kingdom of Assyria' başlar)
not: RIAo (Morello 2022): 'By the fifteenth century, at the zenith of its power, the Mittanian Union encompassed the entire Hurrian-speaking area, from sea to mountains, and imposed a strong pressure on Aššur.' + 'We do not know how Aššur fit into the Mittanian hegemony. The few sources we have at our disposal hint at a certain degree of autonomy.' Hegemonya altındaki hükümdarlar: Nūr-ili … Erība-Adad I (1390-1364 BC). DİKKAT: RIAo 'tâbi' değil 'hegemony/client' diyor ve özerklik vurguluyor; Aššur'u yağmalayan kral RIAo'da Šuttarna, Britannica'da Saustatar (c.1500–c.1450) – başlangıç belirsiz.

suzeren: Hitit (dataset DIŞI — K3 ANADOLU; hitit-1595 bir OLAY kimliği, polity değil)
suzeren_f: ≥-1360 (Tušratta'nın ölümü c.1360 sonrası; Šuppiluliuma I saltanatı içinde Mattiwaza'nın tahta çıkarılması)
not: Britannica: 'The last independent king of Mitanni was Tushratta (died c. 1360 bce), under whose reign Wassukkani was sacked by the Hittite king Suppiluliumas I. Tushratta was later assassinated, and dynastic struggles ensued until Mattiwaza, a son of Tushratta, was aided by Suppiluliumas against Shuttarna of Hurri; thereafter Mitanni became part of the Hittite empire and was called Hanigalbat. Shortly afterward, however, it was captured by the Assyrian Adad-nirari I (reigned c. 1307–c. 1275 bce)'. 'part of the Hittite empire' = Mattiwaza yerinde kral; tâbi krallık olarak okundu. suzeren id 'hitit-1595' Hitit devleti için en yakın id (doğrula). RlA 4 s.106 açılamadı.

suzeren_t: ≤-1245 (Šalmaneser I saltanatı c.1275–c.1245, Britannica; il yapıldı)
not: RIAo Adad-nārārī I: 'Adad-nārāri led the conquest of Mittani in two stages: the campaign against Šattuara I, who submitted to becoming a vassal of Assyria; and the campaign against his rebellious son Usašatta'. RIAo Šalmaneser I: 'Šattura II, king of Ḫanbigalbat, who rebelled against the rule imposed by Shalmaneser's father, Adad-nārāri I' + 'The campaign against Mittani, which marks the end of that kingdom'. Britannica: 'again by Shalmaneser I (reigned c. 1275–c. 1245 bce), who turned the territory east of the Euphrates River into an Assyrian province.' Arada Usašatta ve Šattuara II isyanları (kesintili tâbilik).

Adad-nārārī II 2 (RIMA 2 A.0.99.2) 'I marched to the city Sirqu … which Mudadi of the land Lāqê held. I received a tribute payment, the property of his palace, oxen, agālu-donkeys, the tribute payment (lit. “tribute and payment”) of the land Lāqê, to its full extent, above and below.' (limmu Šamaš-abūʾa; ORACC yıl numarası vermiyor → ②). Tukulti-Ninurta II 05: 'eponymy of Naʾdi-ilu (885)' seferinde 'I received tribute from Mudadi of the city Sirqu' ve 'the audience gift of Ḫamatāyu of the land Laqû' (885 = ① ara kanıt). Aššurnaṣirpal II 001 iii 26b: 'The people of the land Lāqê, the city Ḫindānu, (and) the land Sūḫu, in their entirety, have rebelled' + iii 44b 'I uprooted Ilâ, sheikh of the land Lāqê'. Sonrasında il sistemi (RIAo ANP II sayfası: 're-established widespread administration of it in a system of provinces'). · KASA DÜZELTME: ≤-859 eyaletleşme RlA 6 s.494 tarafından desteklenmiyor ("not a very successful campaign"; yalnız standart yazıtlarda iddia) ⇒ uç ≤-783 ②

ADN II 2: '(I am the one who) received the payment of the land Sūḫu.' TN II 05 (885): 'I received a bountiful audience gift from Ilu-ibni, governor of the land Sūḫu'. ANP II 001: 'in the eponym year of my name (882) … although in the time of the kings, my ancestors, the governor of the land Sūḫu had not come to Assyria, Ilu-ibni, governor of the land Sūḫu … brought silver (and) gold, his payment, to Nineveh' (882 ① ara olay); 878'de Kudurru 'governor of the land Sūḫu. Trusting in extensive Kassite troops' isyan. Bitiş – Suhu online: 'these rulers had been able to shake off the yoke of Assyrian domination some time at the beginning of the eighth century BC' (Šamaš-rēša-uṣur/Ninurta-kudurrī-uṣur) → ③. Tiglath-pileser III dönemi yeniden bağlanma araştırılmadı.

Shalmaneser III 008: 'In my ninth regnal year, in my second campaign (to Babylonia) … I went down to Chaldea (and) captured their cities. I marched to the sea, which is called the Bitter Sea, (and), in Babylon, received the payment of Adīnu of (Bīt-)Dakkūri … (and) Mušallim-Marduk of (Bīt-)Amukkāni'. Šalmaneser III 858–824 (RIAo) → 9. yıl = -850. Bīt-Dakkūri/Bīt-Amukāni; tek seferlik ödeme olabilir, süreklilik kanıtlanmadı.

Bīt-Yakīn. Tiglath-pileser III 47: '(As for) Marduk-apla-iddina (II) (Merodach-baladan) of (the land Bīt)-Yakīn … a king of the Sea (land) who had not come before any of the kings, my ancestors … came to the city Sapīya (Šapīya), before me, and kissed my feet. I received as his payment…'; Bīt-Dakkūri'den 'I received the payment of Balāssu'. Bitiş: ABC 1 i.32 'In the month Nisannu, Marduk-apla-iddina ascended the throne in Babylon' (livius notu: Šalmaneser V ölümü 722/721, tahta çıkış fiilen ertesi yıl) → -721 ①.

ABC 1 ii.23–29: 'When he withdrew, Sennacherib put Bêl-ibni on the throne in Babylon. [ii.24] The first year of Bêl-ibni: [702/701] … [ii.26] The third year of Bêl-ibni: [700/699] … He led away to Assyria Bêl-ibni and his officers. [ii.29] For three years Bêl-ibni ruled Babylon.' Bu dönem Babil'i (MÖ 729–626) listede ayrı polity değil; yeni-babil 626'da başlıyorsa kapsam dışı – id eşlemesini koordinatör yapmalı.

ABC 1 ii.30–43: 'Sennacherib, Aššur-nadin-šumi, his son, he put on the throne in Babylon. [ii.32] The first year of Aššur-nadin-šumni: [699/698] … [ii.42] Aššur-nadin-šumni was taken prisoner and transported to Elam. [ii.43] For six years, Aššur-nadin-šumni ruled Babylon.' Assur veliahtı/kral oğlu – tâbi kral mı kişisel birlik mi tartışmalı; kronik 'put on the throne' der.

ABC 1 ii.44–46: 'The king of Elam put Nergal-ušezib in Babylon on the throne. He effected an Assyrian retreat. [ii.46] The first year of Nergal-ušezib: [693/692]'; iii.4–6: 'He was taken prisoner in the battlefield and transported to Assyria. For one year - precisely: six months - Nergal-ušezib ruled Babylon.' Elam'ın yerleştirdiği kral; 'vassal' kelimesi kaynakta yok.

ABC 1 iv.33–34: 'Šamaš-šuma-ukin and Aššurbanipal, his two sons, ascended the throne in Babylon and Assyria respectively. [iv.34] The accession year of Šamaš-šuma-ukin: [668/667.]'. Bitiş ABC 16 l.9–11: 'The sixteenth year of Šamaš-šuma-ukin: [652/651 BCE.] … On the nineteenth day of the month Tebêtu hostilities began between Assyria and Akkad.' (Tebêtu ≈ Ocak 651 olabilir). Iranica Elam i: 'his brother Šamaš-šum-ukin, whom he had installed on the throne of Babylon'. Kandalanu (647–627, livius: 'possibly identical to Aššurbanipal') belirsiz – satır açılmadı.

Iranica ELAM i: 'the best-known sukkalmah of the dynasty is Siwe-palar-huppak, who for at least two years was the most powerful person in the Near East. According to the royal archives of Mari, kings as important as Zimri-Lim of Mari and Hammurabi of Babylon addressed him as “father,” while calling each other “brother” … Siwe-palar-huppak’s suzerainty was broken by an alliance led by Hammurabi'. Iranica yıl vermiyor (lead: 1765–1764 Orta Kr.); bibliyografyada Charpin–Durand 'La suzeraineté de l’empereur (sukkalmah) d’Élam sur la Mésopotamie'. Hiyerarşik 'baba' hitabı = nominal suzerenlik, haraç kanıtı alıntılanmadı.

Aynı Iranica pasajı: 'kings as important as Zimri-Lim of Mari and Hammurabi of Babylon addressed him as “father,”' … 'Siwe-palar-huppak’s suzerainty was broken by an alliance led by Hammurabi, which put an end to Elamite ambitions in Mesopotamia.' Süre 'at least two years'.

Iranica ELAM i: 'Assurbanipal, who, after the battle of the Ulaï in 653, put an end to the king’s life. After this victory Aššurbanipal installed in power the son of Urtak, who had taken refuge in Assyria. Humban-nikaš II (Akkadian Ummanigaš) was installed at Madaktu … and Tammaritu at Hidalu' + 'Tammaritu captured the throne of Humban-nikaš II and was in turn driven out to Assyria by Indabigaš, who was himself killed by Humban-haltaš III in 648.' Bitiş (Ummanigaš'ın Šamaš-šum-ukin isyanına katılması) bu kaynakta yıllı değil → ③.
